text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega's debut race is finally here. T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto are watching from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road has come along as well, and the cheering of the three classmates is heard throughout the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega seems unfazed, completely locked in on the race and her goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her heart pounds—the remaining trace of her late sister trembles with excitement and anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Promising to achieve victory to satisfy her sister, Admire Vega dashes off, full of determination.
